description.en: Computes a camera position/reference pair by orbiting a given distance, horizontal angle and vertical angle around a reference point — the inverse of CalcPosRefToDistRot.
3-element array [x, y, z] with the reference point to orbit around.
3-element array [distance, horizontalAngleDeg, verticalAngleDeg] describing the orbit.
A 6-element array [posX, posY, posZ, refX, refY, refZ] with the computed camera position and the original reference point.

example.code:
// Compute a camera position orbiting a reference point by a given distance/angle
local posref = GetDistRotCameraPos(cam_ctrl.now_ref, dhv);
